document.abstract: This document defines UHDTV video payload mapping into Single-link, Dual-link, Quad-link or Octa-link 10G-SDI Mode D defined in SMPTE ST 435-2. This document also defines mapping of ANC, Audio Data, payload ID and other ancillary data formatted as defined in SMPTE ST 291-1. The “Basic Stream” complies with the interleaved data stream defined in SMPTE ST 292-1 and is utilized as the input source stream s for the 10G-SDI. — When transporting UHDTV1,2 signals through a single single-mode fiber, WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) or DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing) as defined in Section 6.4 and Section 7.4 may be used.
